bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money for grants to public television.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; PUBLIC TELEVISION.

$5,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $5,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for grants to the Minnesota Public Television Association for production and acquisition grants according to Minnesota Statutes, section 129D.18.
additions: $5,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $5,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for grants to the Minnesota Public Television Association for production and acquisition grants according to Minnesota Statutes, section 129D.18.
